ROOT.functiondef: CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ESKLEP_WyliczIloscBezRezerwacji(@str varchar(255),@uwzglRez tinyint) RETURNS DECIMAL(15,4) AS BEGIN DECLARE @wartosc DECIMAL(15,4) set @wartosc = CAST(CDN.SubstringEx(@str,':',1) AS DECIMAL(15,4))-CASE WHEN @uwzglRez = 1 THEN CAST(CDN.SubstringEx(@str,':',3) AS DECIMAL(15,4)) ELSE 0 END IF @wartosc < 0 set @wartosc = 0 return @wartosc END
